title: Jagged Dense Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and adventurous Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb, cilantro, and shio-koji-cure, with a dense and mustardy texture, this recipe is perfect for those looking for a unique culinary experience.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together shio-koji, yellow mustard, olive oil, garlic, ginger, turmeric, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked through.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro over the kebabs and serve immediately.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as rice or roasted vegetables.
